metadata.description: Legal AI skills for crypto-asset regulation, web3 transactions, protocol law and legal operations.

plugins.name: lowyr-crypto-regulatory
plugins.description: EU/UK crypto-asset regulatory toolkit: MiCA token classification, white paper review, CASP perimeter mapping, crypto promotions review, token distribution analysis, consultation responses and multi-jurisdiction regulatory research.

plugins.name: lowyr-web3-transactions
plugins.description: Commercial and corporate toolkit for blockchain businesses: web3 contract drafting with a token-aware clause library, market-making agreement review against market-abuse rules, and group/jurisdiction structuring.

plugins.name: lowyr-protocol-legal
plugins.description: Where law meets code: map smart-contract control surfaces to legal exposure (decentralisation, custody, disclosure, liability), plus a dual legal/technical Web3 expert for fundraising instruments, DAO structures, US securities analysis and security audits.

plugins.name: lowyr-legal-ops
plugins.description: Legal operations for in-house teams: AI governance (EU AI Act-aligned code of ethics, acceptable use, vendor due diligence) and risk-based legal intake triage that routes work to the right skill.
